evidence_items.explanation: The public report documents a completed evaluation using generative vision-language models for copyright detection. The event date is the release of that empirical report; individual testing dates are not specified.

The released evaluation documents mistaken copyright classifications and analyzes reliance on isolated character features. This meets the operational reading of substantive screening errors, subject to the authors' acknowledged limits on legal ground truth.
